summary: Prepare isolated iOS test-client scanning keys and separate claim/completion proofs; submission fails closed pending the generated SDK

replay.detail: Existing completed pairings retain their credentials and keys.

schema.detail: No generated SDK files are changed.

rules.detail: When Expo extra.testClientMode is true, create the device key before opening the camera, require pairing-key-binding v2, and use distinct pairing.claim.v1 and pairing.complete.v1 possession proofs with that same key. Both submissions currently refuse pending the generated SDK; there is no unbound fallback.

compatibility.detail: Absent or false testClientMode preserves the normal app pairing path. The test variant cannot complete a new pairing until the generated claim/completion SDK bindings ship.

downtime.detail: No deployment or native build is performed.

manual.detail: The test app reports that scanning-key proof submission is unavailable; update after the generated SDK ships. Normal app pairing instructions are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Cancelled or refused scans discard their candidate keys without replacing the saved pairing.
